basis: Independent expected outcomes derived from #988 seed/lock/acceptance contracts and #2638 eager/deferred role constraints; never generated by the candidate DSL parser.
notes: All stage names, statuses and digests in this file are fixture vocabulary, not existing TEI APIs or a new Runtime schema.
The proposal distinguishes staging, current activation, historical acceptance, actual Build, Host authority and Provider effect.
Do not turn source/role/pure declarations into a trust root, actual operator registration, Owner decision, or Host Grant.
A failed/unknown cutover requires durable reread and reconciliation; no blind rollback or retry.

BS-02, BS-03 and BS-06 are tested by a limited Go Reference in Draft #3028; their actual execution status is external exact-head CI evidence, not this expected-data file. Other cases remain design-level expectations.

cases.focus: K0 seed cannot be authorized by the DSL it will parse
cases.expectedBasis: The first parser cannot establish the authenticity of its own trusted root

cases.focus: manifest must be read by seed reader before selecting language
cases.expectedBasis: main Workspace loader supports manifest format versions 1/2; unknown future versions are not silently downgraded

cases.focus: same language ID but different parser implementation bytes
cases.expectedBasis: An exact implementation pin requires content identity, not just ID and semver

cases.focus: eager self-description cycle cannot nominate its own first parser
cases.expectedBasis: A completion prerequisite cycle has no first resolvable interpreter, regardless of declaration order

cases.focus: recursive typed data reference is not eager interpreter recursion
cases.expectedBasis: A deferred type reference has no pre-parse evaluation prerequisite; it still conveys no Owner acceptance

cases.focus: operator contract is unpinned after valid syntax
cases.expectedBasis: Syntactic success cannot substitute an unpinned Operator contract or silently use v1

cases.focus: Canonical candidate cannot be its own Required Shape authority
cases.expectedBasis: An independent acceptance obligation may not be discharged by the candidate's own empty declaration

cases.focus: partial staged registration must not expose half an Operator set
cases.expectedBasis: Candidate generation visibility is all-or-none; without staging isolation the old generation is not proven intact

cases.focus: restart with an incomplete staged candidate
cases.expectedBasis: Restart must not publish a staged subset or infer activation from files merely existing

cases.focus: parse and conformance success without external Owner decision
cases.expectedBasis: A parser, conformance fixture, or AI candidate cannot authorize an Accepted Meaning transition

cases.focus: candidate build succeeded before Owner acceptance
cases.expectedBasis: A candidate build may exist for tests but is neither a release nor proof of accepted Meaning or Host authority

cases.focus: external Owner acceptance and complete closure allow an activation proposal
cases.expectedBasis: Accepted Meaning, durable generation cutover and actual Build receipts are different independently verified events

cases.focus: ack lost during activation must be reconciled before retry
cases.expectedBasis: A lost response cannot distinguish no-write from applied-write and cannot justify replay or rollback

cases.focus: A-B-A exact source bytes do not revive a withdrawn review
cases.expectedBasis: Byte equality alone is not Owner reacceptance, interpreter epoch identity or current authority

cases.focus: new seed parser grammar unsupported by old trusted reader
cases.expectedBasis: An incompatible grammar update requires an independently trusted migration/seed path; self-description cannot bootstrap its own recognition
